why: Build step for ticket 1067 in next/ and our tooling: wrote next/packages/vitest/src/Recorder.ts (layer, both forms of calls, and Method, Args, Failure, Call, Fails, Recorded), exported it from the package index, and added the package description, the glossary row and the pattern doc .patterns/a-law-watches-calls-with-a-recorder.md. R1 to R13 green, one file at a time. The module holds no type assertion: impl goes through a Proxy into Effect's own Layer.mock, the store keeps plain { method, args } entries, and calls reads them back through two overload signatures. Every plant of R1 to R11 was run again on the real module and each was red.
note: Three calls the plan left open: Layer.unwrap over a fresh Ref in place of Layer.effectContext, so each build starts empty (85%); impl is typed Layer.PartialEffectful<S> & object, since a Proxy needs an object and the generic Simplify type does not prove one (85%); a method in fails that impl leaves out dies with UnimplementedError, because whether it answers an Effect or a Stream is read from impl's own answer (80%). R1 to R4 plants were run with the vitest package's own tsc, not a whole pnpm typecheck.
